images.filename: Le 4 mars 2015 - Paris, France- Martin Kobler s’est entretenu avec Irina Bokova, Directeur Général de l’UNESCO. (16730287002).jpg
images.caption: 4 March 2015 – Paris, France: Martin Kobler met Irina Bokova, UNESCO Director General, to discuss the common MONUSCO – UNESCO commitment to protect the 5 World Heritage Sites in DRC: Virunga, Kahuzi-Biega, Garamba and Salonga National Parks as well as the Okapi Wildlife Reserve.
